resources.string: Measures what this phone\'s Bluetooth can send: how many advertising sets open at once, how fast their data can change, and whether extended advertising works. For a few seconds it sends test signals without any name, and it keeps nothing.
Bluetooth is off. Switch it on and run the check again.
Without permission to send Bluetooth signals the check cannot run.
Consent for the Zangbundel test build

This test build of Zangbundel keeps a log file on this phone about how the Bluetooth connection works: how many broadcast channels open, how many messages are repeated or requested again, how many connections succeed or fail, signal strength in coarse steps, the number of participants, the Android version, the phone\'s Bluetooth capabilities and the battery level.
The file holds no names, no campfire name, no lyrics, no keys or codes and no phone addresses.
It leaves the phone only when you share it yourself, through the share menu.
You can stop at any time: uninstall the test build and the file is gone. Taking part is voluntary. Questions: zangbundel@rfsee.nl.
I am 18 or older, I have read this and I take part.
